title: Independent columns of a bond-space basis matrix mark acyclic arc sets
statement: Let $D$ be a digraph with finite vertex set $V$ and finite arc set $A$, each arc $a$ assigned a tail and a head in $V$, and let $F$ be a field. Write $\mathcal{B} \le (A \to F)$ for the bond space of $D$, the space of potential differences $\delta p$ arising from functions $p$ on $V$. Suppose $B$ is a basis matrix of $\mathcal{B}$, so that the rows of $B$ form a basis of $\mathcal{B}$, and let $S \subseteq A$. Then the columns of the restricted matrix $B \mid S$, indexed by the arcs in $S$, are linearly independent over $F$ if and only if $S$ is acyclic, i.e. contains no arc-cycle of $D$.
hypotheses_covered: B is a basis matrix of the bond space of D over F
S is a subset of the arc set A
conclusion: columns of B restricted to S are linearly independent iff S is acyclic
